title: ZOE log replay result
description: One run of the log replay, B6 of the specification: the timed transactions of a store that a run of B5 kept, replayed against ZEO 6 through ZEO.ClientStorage (zeo) and against zoe serve through the native client (zoe-native), in alternating runs, on one machine. Results are numbers about a synthetic site, never data.

speed.description: A multiple of the speed of the log.

started.description: The start of the replay, in seconds since the epoch.

log.description: The log that the replay read.

store.description: The path of the FileStorage of the log.

base.description: The transactions before the first timed one.

starts.description: How the starts of the transactions came from the probe records of the run.

matched.description: Transactions whose start is the start of a request that committed.

unmatched.description: Transactions that no request explains. They start at their commit.

requests.description: The requests of the probe records that committed.

runs.description: One item per run, in the order of the runs: for each speed, for each repetition, one run of each stack.

transactions.description: The timed transactions that the run replayed.

order.description: The tids of the log in the order in which the run ended their commits.

conflicts.description: The oids in conflict at a vote, by class (module.name) and by what ended the conflict.

conflict_errors.description: The ConflictErrors that the commits raised: the ones that reach Zope.

acknowledged.description: The acknowledged transactions that the check got.

missing.description: The tids of the acknowledged transactions of which a record does not load.

counts.description: True when the check found nothing missing. A run that does not count stays out of the gate.

seconds.description: From the first start of the schedule to the end of the last commit.
